title: Round and Round the Potter’s Wheel
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The Lord said, "Jeremiah, go
Down to the potter's place";
The wheel went turning round and round
At slow and steady pace.

[Chorus]
Oh, round and round the potter's wheel,
The clay is in His hand;
And if it bends, He shapes it new,
Just as His love has planned.

[Verse 2]
One little pot came out all wrong,
It slumped and leaned and fell;
The potter gathered up the clay
And made it new as well.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Like clay within the potter's hand,
We rest in hands so kind;
He never throws a heart away
Or leaves a child behind.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
The snowman Wren made flopped aside,
Her lip began to fall;
Then Grandma smiled and rolled the dough
Back to a smooth round ball.

[Chorus]
mood: Turning music. A slow, rolling fingerpicked pattern that circles back on itself like a potter's wheel, unhurried and even, with a soft low bass note holding the centre the way two steady hands hold the clay. Each verse the pattern comes round again a little warmer, and it ends on a bright, settled feeling of starting over.
